purpose: Falsify at minimum cost whether independent ILS can both search alone and add verified value when it receives a complete HGS solution, before any matched-budget A-to-B performance run.

warm_start_selection.metric: minimum HGS-M_cost over the five sealed v7 seeds
warm_start_selection.reason: Use the pure mechanism_ev HGS arm, not the MV-HGS-SP route-pool fusion, so the warm lane is a genuine HGS-to-ILS handoff.

v7_reference_route_pool.route_signature: customer sequence only, canonical up to reversal; routes with fewer than two customers do not count as order novelty
v7_reference_route_pool.adjacency_signature: undirected customer-customer edges only; depot edges excluded

candidate_observation_and_selection.during_search: record immutable returned solutions, first-seen order, canonical signature, and proxy objective only; no complete evaluation
candidate_observation_and_selection.offline_selection: official final best plus lowest proxy-objective distinct candidates, ties by first-seen order then canonical signature
candidate_observation_and_selection.final_task_output: lowest exact objective among selected candidates that pass shared completion, global check, and exact scoring

parallelism.reason_not_8: Only six independent homogeneous tasks exist; duplicating tasks would change the preregistered experiment.

on_stop: Do not tune or rerun on the registered instances
Do not launch A+B performance testing
next_gate_if_pass: HGS-ILS-XD-G1 matched-budget A24/B24/A-long48/B-long48/A-to-B48 on three separate result-blind instances; no midpoint exchange or route-pool stage
